title: NBI search of Surigao mayor’s house in Agusan yields no guns

blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) agents searched Wednesday morning the residence of Barobo, Surigao del Sur Mayor Ronito Martizano for guns but failed to find any. The NBI team from the National Capital Region (NCR) arrived at Martizano’s home in Barangay Hubang here, at around 6 a.m. and searched the property for nearly an hour. The operation was carried out based on Search Warrant No. 370-2026 issued by the Regional Trial Court of Prosperidad, Agusan del Sur, in connection with alleged violation of Republic Act No. 10591, or the Comprehensive Firearms and Ammunition Regulation Act.
